project_justification.fill: The project proves exact Gaussian grid embedding, quantitative boundary-stable transfer for the discontinuous rejection surfaces, uniform Bayes and oracle convergence, minimax-regret convergence, and predictable finite-policy attainment. For policy recovery it Markovizes a selected finite rule at the score--clock state under the zero-drift reference law, preserves every declared scenario terminal risk by terminal likelihood tilting, regularizes the finitely many action kernels simultaneously, and then applies a continuous-kernel block construction. It also proves termination of a deterministic nested interval-Bellman search whose corrected scaled-datum modulus and actual error ledger validate both the value interval and an independently re-evaluated policy mixture.

statement_notes.justification: It identifies the attainable local-power regret frontier for the fixed confirmatory test on every finite bounded scenario list. Its reverse policy transfer first integrates hidden history and correlated randomization into zero-drift score--clock action kernels, preserves all scenario terminal risks exactly by likelihood tilting, and only then regularizes those kernels for predictable finite-stage block recovery.
statement_notes.consumer: It converts a continuum recruitment solution into asymptotically equivalent finite-stage policies for interAdapt-style subgroup-enrichment designs without forced exploration or an assumption that allocation counts encode ordered history.
